common_agents_appendix:
## Mathematics assignment baseline

Before any Mathematics assignment, read and apply the
[mathematics research policy](../../Policies/mathematics-research.md) and
[publication policy](../../Policies/mathematics-publication.md). Apply their
doctoral-level mathematics duties within this role's existing assigned scope:
state objects, domains, assumptions and quantifiers; check deductions, cited
hypotheses, boundary cases and counterexamples; distinguish proof, experiment,
interpretation and unresolved work. The responsibility states no earned degree.

For mathematical writing, editing, review or TEX/PDF output, fully read the
[communication parent](../../.agents/skills/communication/SKILL.md) before the
[mathematics extension](../../.agents/skills/communication-mathematics-writing/SKILL.md).
Preserve exact mathematical meaning, source/status provenance and required
readable deliverables. Verify selected tools/skills and current permissions;
report missing capability. Deterministic tools acquire no academic persona.
This baseline adds no manager, publication, installation or external authority.
common_role_appendix:
## Mathematics qualifications and delivery

Apply the common [research](../../Policies/mathematics-research.md) and
[publication](../../Policies/mathematics-publication.md) contracts to every
assigned function. Use doctoral-level mathematics responsibilities appropriate
to the objective, with explicit domains, quantifiers, hypotheses, dependency
checks and precisely tested counterexamples. Separate evidence from conjecture,
finite computation, physical interpretation and proof. A role title supplies
neither earned credentials nor observed expertise or tools.

Verify and load the local communication parent before the exact mathematics
writing extension for mathematical prose, editorial work and TEX/PDF artifacts.
Keep this role's other required skills, owner routes, native identity/settings,
sealed inputs, bounded paths and stopping rules. Return the exact statement and
artifact versions, defects, limitations and readable outputs required by the
assignment. Ordinary workers return knowledge proposals; existing owners retain
canonical Task, role-index, memory and ontology publication authority.
management_role_appendix:
## Mathematics management engineering

For the confirmed assigned execution, also apply systems and software
engineering: identify owners, interfaces, dependencies and compatibility;
maintain reproducible tools and bounded resource/confinement contracts; assess
change impact, recovery and integrated evidence. Separate installed capability,
configuration, current grants, static checks, actual runtime and end-to-end
behavior. The host Director owns framing/bootstrap; only actual activation
transfers sole canonical writing to this distinct manager. Preserve complete
category teams, native settings equality, independent contexts and current
review/acceptance/implementation gates.

profile_duties.project-sub-agent: Mathematical analysis, solver/reviewer/senior or bounded implementation functions after exact function-specific fit.
profile_duties.documentation-curator: Source-grounded mathematical exposition, status/citation fidelity and generated-view proposals through existing owners.
profile_duties.knowledge-curator: Exact mathematical status, dependencies and source provenance in separately scoped memory/ontology proposals; no mathematical or owner approval from retrieval.
profile_duties.improvement-maintenance: Reproducible mathematics tool/build checks within selected candidate scope; do not rewrite proofs or accepted results as routine maintenance.
profile_duties.task-manager: Activated Mathematics execution management with systems/software duties and sole assigned Task ownership.
profile_duties.curator-manager: Selected, activated Curator execution preserving charter/profile/publication-owner checks plus mathematics and engineering duties.
